title: Security fix for GHSA-gcjh-h69q-9w9g applied in: kedacore-http-add-on 0.14.0-r2, kedacore-http-add-on 0.13.0-r2
description: A security vulnerability identified as GHSA-gcjh-h69q-9w9g affects multiple versions of the kedacore-http-add-on package. The issue has been addressed in versions 0.14.0-r2 and 0.13.0-r2. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS 4.0 base score of 6.3, indicating a network attack vector with low complexity and no privileges required. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
